pdf_comparison.baseline: reviewed rc.9 source PDFs, same runtime/architecture

observations: Cover and chapter families, accent colors, line spacing and margins reflect the authored settings.
Reviewed title, contents, proof/math/table, prose/footnote and index layouts show no clipping or overlapping content.
Pagination changes are expected; existing unstyled page pixels are compared separately.

history.head: 887dde95f9ce5d81b6b8d916f1a2ed42c9c4a89a
history.finding: Standalone Docker recipe retained rc.9 after source version bump; version-consistency helper rejected the mismatch.
The first cross-delivery comparison included pdf.enabled; native --pdf overrides saved false, while Next uses saved true.
history.resolution: Compare style, paper, font size, revision, text and pixels while explicitly verifying each expected enabled value; rendering is unchanged.

limits: Print stays English/LTR; no custom font paths or raw LaTeX preambles.
Passing acceptance does not prove zero bugs or 1.0 completeness.
